name: Richard "richeeta" Hyunho Im
biography: Richard Hyunho Im (@richeeta) is a senior security engineer and independent vulnerability researcher at Route Zero Security. Currently ranked among the top 25 researchers in OpenAI's bug bounty program, Richard has also received security acknowledgements from Apple (CVE-2025-24198, CVE-2025-24225, CVE-2025-30468, and CVE-2024-44235), Microsoft, Google, and the BBC. His research highlights overlooked attack surfaces, focusing on practical exploitation that challenges assumptions about everyday software security.
